notes.title: Loot Shop Simulator | New Game Announcement!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3644050/Loot_Shop_Simulator/


[b]Welcome to Loot Shop Simulator[/b] – the cozy, fantasy shop sim where you open all of the loot boxes… and then resell the loot to your (extremely loyal) customers! Decorate your shop, hoard rare gear, and hustle cursed swords to adventurers on suspiciously personal quests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42957930/fa73dc1b2a1ca1d78ababadd92383e98ad0940c8.gif[/img]

[b]Crack Boxes, Get Rich[/b]

Open a variety of loot boxes from totally legitimate, fantasy sets like Legend of the NFT-Eyed, Lootbox Dragon and Wrath of the Witch King! Get swords, get sparkles, get mildly suspicious rings. Then sell them. For gold.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42957930/9588851a02d8def92e8139bc4833254f010da6fb.gif[/img]

[b]Collect the Good Stuff[/b]

Each loot set has its own wacky theme and shiny nonsense. From humble Irony Swords to legendary pray-to-win artifacts, stock your shelves with treasure and flex your rarest finds.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42957930/d950deb1b7c6c7a26894a32a7225c2706b562b79.gif[/img]

[b]Expand That Empire[/b]

Decorate your shop and expand your way to retail domination!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42957930/b7c83a9e68d4e3570f3299716e72f45a1b1b417a.gif[/img]


[h3]Wishlist today![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3644050/Loot_Shop_Simulator/

notes.title: Our next game, Imaginal Voyages, is releasing in Early Access on April 24th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42957930/d4ab8a3a00b7a5d980a350d701e6271b3c298e76.png[/img]


Our upcoming game is set to launch in Early Access on April 24th!

Our studio, Source Error Productions, is passionate about narrative-driven adventures. In contrast to [b]Awakening of Legend[/b], which heavily emphasized gameplay, we've opted for a different approach with our latest project – a game centered entirely on the story.

Introducing [b]Imaginal Voyages[/b], a thought-provoking science fiction Visual Novel anthology featuring distinct stories and characters in each episode. These short episodes, akin to anime episodes, delve into themes surrounding human nature, psychology, and cutting-edge technology.


[previewyoutube=P6wzH1P0O0Q;full][/previewyoutube]

On Early Access launch day, the first episode of [b]Imaginal Voyages[/b] will be totally free!

---
[h3]Episode 1 - The Stowaway[/h3]

[i]On the desolate mining planet of Arcallum Tau a mysterious illness has ravaged its inhabitants, plunging the once orderly community into pandemonium.

Amidst the chaos, Communications Officer Aiden Keane rushes to rejoin his crew aboard The Whipple, but fate has a different plan in store for him. Upon boarding, he is startled to find a small girl named Mia who desperately pleads for his aid.

Will Aiden Keane risk everything to help her, even if it means putting his crew in peril?[/i]
---


Don't miss the opportunity to immerse yourself in the diverse narratives and intriguing characters that await you in each episode. Visit the Steam page, add [b]Imaginal Voyages[/b] to your wishlist, and stay tuned for the Early Access release on April 24th. We can't wait to share this unique experience with you!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2355920/Imaginal_Voyages/
